title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Computation Sheet: Credit on Filing for Single-Use Card Overcharges
content:
**Computation sheet, Pocketwire Visa Debit Card.** This sheet covers the credit given on filing for an incorrect-amount dispute of a purchase made with a single-use virtual card.

**A. The on-filing ceiling.** The ceiling is the card tier's small-dispute threshold multiplied by the tenure multiplier and rounded to the cent (half up), plus the deposit uplift, the plan uplift, the standing uplift and the merchant acknowledgement uplift.

**B. The credit on filing.** The credit on filing is the lower of the overcharge on record and the on-filing ceiling, rounded to the cent (half up).

**C. Values.** The tenure multiplier is 1, and the deposit, plan, standing and merchant acknowledgement uplifts are each 0.00.

**D. The overcharge on record.** The disputed amount of the incorrect-amount disputes filed on the single-use card, less the disputed amount of those already resolved.

**Grouping.** Only the product of the small-dispute threshold and the tenure multiplier is rounded before the uplifts are added. The four uplifts are then added to that rounded product to give the ceiling. The credit on filing compares the ceiling with the overcharge on record.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

Hypothetical input: a single-use card on a tier whose small-dispute threshold is 25.00. The ceiling is 25.00 multiplied by 1, which is 25.00, plus 0.00 four times, which is 25.00.

| Incorrect-amount disputes on the card | Overcharge on record | On-filing ceiling | Credit on filing |
|---|---|---|---|
| one filed for 18.40, not resolved | 18.40 | 25.00 | 18.40 |
| one filed for 42.00, not resolved | 42.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| one filed for 42.00, already resolved | 0.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 |

On a tier whose small-dispute threshold is 50.00, the ceiling is 50.00. The 42.00 overcharge in the second row would then be credited in full, at 42.00.
